What your Free First Visit includes

The Free First Visit is a calm first step for new local students. See the room, walk through safety, discuss your goals and schedule, and get guidance toward an appropriate coached class. Youth visits use the parent and guardian workflow.

  1. Reserve your first visit. Choose the lane that fits who is starting.
  2. See the room. Learn the safety flow and talk through your goals.
  3. Choose the next step. Sandy guides you toward an appropriate class and starting pace.

Your first class is a coached learning experience.

If you decide to continue:

New local students choose a 1×, 2×, or 3× weekly Core Culture frequency. Twelve-week Youth prices are $220 / $440 / $550; Adult prices are $275 / $550 / $687.50. Eligible first terms include the 30-Day Training Fit Guarantee after at least four classes in the first 30 days; full terms apply.

Frequently Asked Questions

What happens at a beginner BJJ first visit in Tannersville?
Start with a 15-minute Free First Visit. Adults can choose to train that day. Sandy must confirm the class first. You can choose sparring too. This means live practice with a matched partner. You can pause or end a round at any time. Youth use their own visit and class plan. For youth, a parent or guardian joins the visit.
What should I wear?
Adults: For a visit, wear your own day clothes. To train, wear clean sports clothes. Follow Sandy's class and arrival plan. Youth and teens: clean athletic clothes for the coached class. They may train during their visit. Follow the Gi/No-Gi instructions Sandy confirms for the first class.
Do I need to be fit?
No. Jiu-Jitsu is how you get in shape. You can take breaks whenever you need them, and you will progress at a pace that feels comfortable and sustainable for you.
Can I reschedule?
Text Sandy at +1 (917) 736-8649 and we will look for another day and time. Youth requests include one complimentary change; a second missed appointment needs manual review.

"A welcoming community with no big egos. That's rare in any martial art." - Adam M.

Adults: choose your first day

Meet Sandy for your first visit. Then choose to train that day or come back for class. Sandy confirms the plan with you.

For a visit, wear your own day clothes. To train, wear clean sports clothes. Follow Sandy's class and arrival plan.

Live partner practice

Sparring is live practice with a partner. You can choose to try it on day one. Sandy matches the partner and pace. You can pause or end a round at any time.

The Sandy Challenge

Try a timed round with Sandy. A belt holds his arms at his sides. He uses movement to defend. You both agree on rules first. Either of you can say "pause" to end the round. Sandy releases the belt when the round ends. You choose if you take part.

Sandy confirms each class and the plan first. Fill out your waiver before you train.
